responsibility: Declares the tree-affine abstraction used by GCC middle-end analyses to model expressions as affine combinations of tree operands. It defines aff_comb_elt and aff_tree, the MAX_AFF_ELTS bounded representation, cache-facing expansion interfaces, conversion and arithmetic helpers, address/reference helpers, overlap queries, and small predicates for recognizing zero, constant, and singleton-variable affine forms that are consumed by loop optimizers and data-reference analysis.
same_name_distinction: Provides the data model and public interface for affine tree combinations, declaring aff_tree/aff_comb_elt, limits like MAX_AFF_ELTS, inline predicates, and function prototypes that tree-affine.cc implements.
